build_zero_shot_audio_classifier: build a zero-shot audio classification pipeline using the CLAP model from HuggingFace transformers
test_small_model_float32: test the zero-shot audio classification pipeline with a tiny CLAP model in float32 precision
test_small_model_float16: test the zero-shot audio classification pipeline with a tiny CLAP model in float16 precision
test_large_model_batched: test the zero-shot audio classification pipeline with the full CLAP model using batched audio inputs
run_zero_shot_audio_inference: run zero-shot audio classification inference with candidate labels on audio data from a HuggingFace dataset
